entry.title: 独立开发者的开发者市场陷阱

link.title: 独立开发者的开发者市场陷阱

entry.summary: 你可能听过这样的建议：“从自己的需求出发”。这种方法确保了产品的真实性，降低了风险，并让你能够打造真正在意的东西。但对于以其他技术人员为客户的独立开发者1来说，这种方法并非总是理想的选择。 我在这篇文章中有意避免使用”独立黑客“这个术语，因为那将包括不涉及软件工程的创作者，尽管我猜这也适用于其中的一些人，但不是全部。 ↩

entry.title: The developer market trap for indies

link.title: The developer market trap for indies

entry.summary: You’ve likely heard the advice: “Start with your own needs”. This approach ensures authenticity, reduces risk, and allows you to build something you genuinely care about. But for indie developers1 whose customers are fellow techies, this approach may not always be ideal. I intentionally avoided the term “indie hackers” in this post because that will include creators that don’t involve software engineering, though I guess this applies to some of them as well, but not all. ↩

entry.title: 我如何管理了 12 年的笔记

link.title: 我如何管理了 12 年的笔记

entry.summary: 我有一个从2012年开始的Git仓库。在那之前，我记得使用Notational Velocity1和一堆文本文件，它运行得很好，直到我决定将我的笔记保留一辈子。如果我没有将它们数字化，我会在索引卡上写笔记，并将它们存放在盒子里进行组织。只要我能保存这些盒子，我就能保留我的笔记。 [Notational Velocity][5] 是一个让我快速搜索和切换文件的文本编辑器。后来我转用了[nvALT][6]，这是Notational Velocity的一个分支，增加了一些额外功能和界面修改，包括MultiMarkdown功能。 ↩

entry.title: How I’ve managed notes over 12 years

link.title: How I’ve managed notes over 12 years

entry.summary: I have a Git repository dating back to 2012. Before that, I remember using Notational Velocity1 with a bunch of text files, it worked well, until I decided to keep my notes for life. If I’m not digitizing them, I’ll write notes on index cards and store them in boxes for organizing. As long as I can keep the boxes, I get to keep my notes. [Notational Velocity][5] is a text editor that lets me quickly search and switch between files. Later I switched to [nvALT][6]—a fork of Notational Velocity with some additional features and interface modifications, including MultiMarkdown functionality. ↩

entry.summary: 需求是 VLAN 单线复用，不用 IPTV 但需要把弱电箱里的网口通过一根线交换到另一个房间的路由上，同时兼顾拨号。千兆交换够用，也是考虑到目前更高带宽设备的普及度和性价比后的一个更实际的选择。

entry.title: Home switches comparison
entry.summary: The requirement is VLAN single-line multiplexing. Although IPTV is not needed, I need to switch the network port in the weak current box to a router in another room through a single line, while also accommodating dial-up. Gigabit switching is adequate and a more practical choice after considering the current popularity and cost effectiveness of higher bandwidth devices.
